$comment: The source of truth for the HTTP headers of the site (T2.1). scripts/generate-headers.mjs reads this file after the build and writes dist/_headers, the nginx snippets in apps/web/dist-headers/, and a CSP <meta> tag in each page. The generator adds the SHA-256 hash of each inline script of the build to script-src. Read docs/security-headers.md before you change a value.

toolOverrides.$comment: The preview frames of these tools are srcdoc frames, and a srcdoc frame keeps the policy of its page. Their own meta policy is stricter (no network). 'unsafe-inline' turns off the script hashes, so the hashes are not added on these pages.
